facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan starts at $25 per month on the monthly plan option, per the page.
facts.quote: Launch Recommended for: up to 500 contacts Starting at $25/ Month Starting at $20/ Month Billed Annually

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Launch plan starts at $20 per month when billed annually, per the page.
EZ Texting's Boost plan starts at $75 per month on the monthly plan option, per the page.
facts.quote: Boost Recommended for: 500-2,000 contacts Starting at $75/ Month

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Boost plan starts at $60 per month when billed annually, per the page.
EZ Texting's Scale plan starts at $125 per month on the monthly plan option, per the page.
facts.quote: Scale Recommended for: 2,000-50,000 contacts Starting at $125/ Month

facts.fact: EZ Texting's Scale plan starts at $100 per month when billed annually, per the page.
EZ Texting's Enterprise plan starts at $3,000 per month, per the page, and is recommended for 50,000+ contacts.
facts.quote: Enterprise Recommended for: 50,000+ contacts Starting at $3,000/ Month

facts.fact: The page states that EZ Texting annual plans save up to 20%.
EZ Texting's Launch, Boost, and Scale plans each include 500 monthly credits.
EZ Texting's Launch, Boost, and Scale plans each include 6,000 yearly credits.
EZ Texting's Enterprise plan includes 200,000 monthly credits.
Overage credits on EZ Texting's Launch plan cost $0.04 each.
Overage credits on EZ Texting's Boost plan cost $0.035 each.
Overage credits on EZ Texting's Scale plan cost $0.03 each.
Overage credits on EZ Texting's Enterprise plan cost $0.01 each.
EZ Texting's Launch, Boost, and Scale plans each include one user, per the page.
EZ Texting states its set-up time is within 1 business day for the Launch, Boost, and Scale plans.
EZ Texting states its Enterprise plan set-up time is 4 to 12 weeks.
EZ Texting states that carrier pass-through fees are billed separately based on exact usage.
facts.quote: ** Carrier pass through fees are billed separately based on exact usage

facts.fact: EZ Texting states that an SMS message (text only, 160 characters) uses 1 credit per message sent to each contact.
facts.quote: SMS messages (text only, 160 characters) are 1 credit each

facts.fact: EZ Texting states that an MMS message (including images or video, and/or up to 1600 characters) uses 3 credits per message sent to each contact.
facts.quote: MMS messages (including images or video, and/or up to 1600 characters) are 3 credits each
